description: The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Cost” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10 with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score” and has a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90 with tick labels at intervals of 10. A blue line, representing the “3-Model Ensemble”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (0, 83) and declines to approximately (10, 73). A red line, representing the “2-Model Ensemble”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (0, 88) and declines to approximately (10, 75). A yellow line, representing “GPT-4”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (0, 85) and declines to approximately (10, 40).
